answer: Duplicate identities break on a climb no wallet can batch. A key deposits 1.62 POA into a timed vault for 10 epochs and is issued one lantern with a public 18-byte wick hash. Every 70 minutes it must hang that wick on the next trellis rung, signed from a fresh /22 and bound to the prior rung plus the live tip. Three clerks recompute the chain from the tip and void any reused wick or shared prefix. If two keys reuse one lantern hash, or one wallet posts six rungs in 4 hours, the vault stays sealed and the 1.62 POA is burned. A missed interval snaps the trellis; no makeup wick is accepted.
